Results.ReviewText: Compared to another Weber I had, a Genesis decades ago, this was not well thought-out, aside from the grilling itself:  1. Four revolving caster wheels makes it roll in any direction if you have to push from behind, like a grocery cart.  Better: two forward-reverse wheels, two revolving.  2.  Door frame in front suffers from two much flex.  If you have to tug or push on the side shelves to move the grill over a bumpy surface, the door frame tilts out of square.  Then, the door bottom catches on the frame's threshold.  You have to tug the frame back into squareness.  3.  That hanging hook inside for the tank, to judge its fullness.  Buy a $25 gas gauge and substitute it for the provided supply hose.  Then, to keep the tank from dropping through the hole in the floor, cover the hole with a piece of 1/4" plywood, about 15" square.
Results.Title: Good grill with flaws surprising for Weber

Results.ReviewText: This is my first Weber grill. I wanted to step up to a higher quality BBQ that wasn’t too large for my deck. I have to say this grill cooks great, starts instantly and no flare ups. I would have given it five stars if it weren’t for the grease tray that needs to be cleaned each time you use the grill. The new Spirit II has an improved grease system and the Weber phone rep honestly didn’t explain how much easier it was to clean than the original Spirit I purchased. The grill basically look very similar and I don’t understand why Weber would improve one model and not all of the Spirit line. If I knew then what I know now I would have given more consideration to the Spirit II.
Results.Title: The Spirit is very good but consider the Spirit II

Results.ReviewText: We have owned the Weber Spirit 310 for about 5 years and will buy another if and when the time comes.  I really like the 3 burner configuration. You can turn the middle burner off just having the left and right burners on then place a roast or other large pieces of meat in the center without direct heat under the meat. Sort of like the Weber Kettle design concept. The ignitor works well, and the indicator showing how much LPG is in the tank is nice. This eliminates the need of having to lift the tank by hand to judge the amount of LPG remaining.

Results.ReviewText: Weber clearly sets themselves above the competition here.  I'd been a proud owner of a Char-Broil Commercial series for many years, but the constant replacing of the plates every season (a bi-product of New England winters and coastal living) was less than ideal.  Where the Weber really shines is the consistent cooking every time.  We've had chops (bone in and boneless), various cuts of beef, salmon, and veggies.  Everything comes out incredibly moist, perfect grill marks for presentation, and no flame outs.  Worth the investment!

ClientResponses.Response: Hello, thank you for being a long-time Weber fan. We sincerely apologize for your experience with the crossover tube. We recommend cleaning the crossover tube to remove the debris and allow the gas to transfer from one burner to another. Rest assured, if the crossover tube cracks, we can send a replacement if it's under warranty. Otherwise, cleaning it will do the trick. If you have any other questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to reach out. Thanks!

Results.ReviewText: Not even 2 years old and suddenly Burner #2 and 3 are not lighting. Apparently it's the crossover burner tube that needs replacing which will entail just about taking apart the whole grill, more so than how it arrived!  I am meticulous about cleaning grill after using it, always do so immediately.  I will probably have to hire someone to do the job looking at the complex instructions I have been sent.  NOT at all OK for a Weber BBQ that is not even 2 years old!  Have owned Webers for over 25 years, time to rethink that.  It's hard to give any good ratings when you have a BBQ that is not working.

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
